PZZ700-042015-
1209 AM PDT Sun Oct 4 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 12 AM, a broad 1021 mb high was about 400 nautical miles west 
of the Pacific Northwest coast and a 1009 mb low was over the 
Southern California Bight. Weak to moderate north to northwest 
flow will prevail through next Wednesday, except for weakly 
northeasterly this morning.
